evidence: 386 HTTP requests to port 8080 in about 3 s, 171+ distinct URIs
61 requests carried a Shellshock (CVE-2014-6271) payload in the User-Agent
Probed /cgi-bin, /admin, /backup, /robots.txt, and random-named files; 393 connections to one port
analyses.summary: 10.10.10.10 sent 386 HTTP requests to the admin panel on 8080 in about 3 s. It ran a Nikto-style path and CGI sweep with Shellshock probes, mostly returning 404. This is web vulnerability scanning with no credential guessing or other services touched.
